         EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStarted {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStopped {\n                reason,\n                beads_processed,\n                uptime_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"reason\": reason,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                    \"uptime_secs\": uptime_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerErrored {\n                error_type,\n                error_message,\n                beads_processed,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"error_type\": error_type,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerExhausted {\n                cycle_count,\n                last_strand,\n                waterfall_restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"cycle_count\": cycle_count,\n                    \"last_strand_evaluated\": last_strand,\n                    \"waterfall_restarts\": waterfall_restarts,\n                    \"restart_triggers\": restart_triggers,\n                    \"strand_evaluations\": strand_evaluations,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerIdle { backoff_seconds } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"backoff_seconds\": backoff_seconds })\n            }\n            EventKind::StateTransition { from, to } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"from\": format!(\"{from}\"), \"to\": format!(\"{to}\") })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepStarted {          EventKind::WorkerLaunchDeferred {\n                deferred_count,\n                total_wait_secs,\n                reason,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"deferred_count\": deferred_count,\n                    \"total_wait_secs\": total_wait_secs,\n                    \"reason\": reason\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                strand_name,\n                result,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n EventKind::BeadStoreError {\n                strand_name,\n                operation,\n                error_message,\n                stderr,\n                exit_code,\n                workspace,\n            } => {\n                let mut data = serde_json::json!({\n                    \"strand_name\": strand_name,\n                    \"operation\": operation,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"stderr\": stderr,\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                });\n                if let Some(ws) = workspace {\n                    if let Some(obj) = data.as_object_mut() {\n                        obj.insert(\"workspace\".to_string(), serde_json::json!(ws));\n                    }\n                }\n                data\n            }\n            EventKind::QueueEmpty => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::PluckStarvationDetected {\n                workspace,\n                open_count,\n                excluded_count,\n                candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"workspace\": workspace,\n }\n            EventKind::ClaimAttempt { bead_id, attempt } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"attempt\": attempt })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimSuccess {\n                bead_id,\n                priority,\n                strand,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\":
